label: Landforms and process
text: EA.O.A4.1 Landforms and process. Geomorphology: landforms as products of rock, climate and time. Processes are weathering, mass wasting, fluvial, glacial, aeolian and coastal. A graded river adjusts slope and channel to its water and sediment load. The adjustment is a tendency, not a guarantee. Uniformitarianism is a methodological premise in EA.M.H, cited here.

warrant.standard: Field or remote measurement with accuracy assessment; process model calibrated and validated
